title: UI Test for my WW2 game 25 Points
author: jl2l

comments.author: jl2l
comments.body:
Cooking up a prototype. Would you play?  
  
 Every crew member in your roster—from your cynical tail gunner from Brooklyn to your stoic navigator—is powered by a **Contextual LLM Dialogue System**.

* **Dynamic Reactions:** Your crew remembers the mission. If Engine #4 turned into a torch over Essen, Sgt. Miller will tell you about it in the barracks—in his own voice, influenced by his personality and history.

This runs qwen LLM on the player's machine locally using about 8GB of vram, with a networked fallback if you don't have enough vram.

comments.author: Trashy_io
comments.body: I think its a bit small you could play with like a 10-20% bump in size, game is looking really great tho!

replies.author: jl2l
replies.body: Are you talking about font size?

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body: Id say overall you can play with font size too and possibly highlighting important information in the ui there is a lot of information on screen all at once and its a bit hard to know where I need to start
